definition: Gaël Varoquaux is the co-founder of scikit-learn and Research Director at Inria.
details: Co-created scikit-learn and joblib, providing the foundational classical machine learning library used by millions of practitioners worldwide.

explainer.lead: Gaël Varoquaux is a French research director at Inria and a co-founder of scikit-learn, the most widely used Python library for classical machine learning.
explainer.knownFor: Leading scikit-learn since 2010 and building core scientific-Python tools such as joblib, nilearn and skrub.

contributions.name: scikit-learn
contributions.detail: Took over the project in 2010 with Fabian Pedregosa, Alexandre Gramfort and Vincent Michel and turned it into the standard ML toolkit for Python.

contributions.name: joblib, nilearn and skrub
contributions.detail: joblib for caching and parallel pipelines, nilearn for machine learning on brain images, and skrub for preparing messy tables.

contributions.name: Probabl
contributions.detail: Co-founder and chief science officer of Probabl, the 2023 Inria spin-off that now employs scikit-learn’s core maintainers.

contributions.name: Research
contributions.detail: Leads Inria’s Soda team on AI for health and social data, statistical learning and machine learning on tables.

contributions.name: Teaching
contributions.detail: Created and edited the Scipy Lecture Notes until 2022.

timeline.what: Relaunches scikit-learn at Inria with colleagues
“Scikit-learn: Machine Learning in Python” published in JMLR
